title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
statement:
Given two integer arrays preorder and inorder where preorder is the preorder traversal of a binary tree and inorder is the inorder traversal of the same tree, construct and return the binary tree.

Note: You may assume that duplicates do not exist in the tree.
constraints: preorder and inorder consist of unique values

visibleExamples.explanation: Returns the root of the constructed binary tree. Preorder starts with root (3), inorder has left subtree (9) and right subtree (15,20,7).

jsonFriendlyReason: Return type is Optional[TreeNode], which requires a custom TreeNode adapter for serialization.
